en.label: English
en.acknowledge: Thank you for contacting {clinic}. We have received your inquiry and will have a staff member review it.
en.request_details: Could you confirm whether this is your first visit and your preferred date and time?
en.candidate: Your requested time is within our demonstration opening hours; it is a tentative request, not a confirmed appointment.
en.needs_staff: Questions about symptoms, diagnoses, treatment, and prices must be answered by the clinic's qualified staff. We will forward your question for review.
en.confirmation: A clinic staff member has confirmed the demonstration booking status in our internal log. This is not a real appointment.

faq.hours: Demo hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00–17:00 Japan time. Please verify with the clinic.
faq.location: Demo Shinjuku Dental (fictional). The real address must be confirmed by clinic staff.
faq.first_visit: A first visit is tentatively allocated 60 minutes in this demonstration; clinic staff must confirm.
faq.payment: Accepted payment methods and fees must be confirmed by clinic staff.

zh-Hans.needs_staff: 症状、诊断、治疗方案和费用须由诊所专业人员核实。我们会转交工作人员处理。
zh-Hans.confirmation: 工作人员已在演示台账中确认模拟预约状态。这不是真实预约。
